pages.title: Chronosteel Plating
pages.text: Chronosteel rolled into plates and fixed to a block face. Its sheen is cool and slightly blurred, as if the surface had moved a moment before it was seen. It gives a wall a clean, mechanical look. Rivets mark each corner, set in perfectly even rows.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I had spare chronosteel, so I plated walls with it. The blurred reflections are a side effect of the metal's own clock and I have grown fond of them.
$(thing)Used in$(): Chronosteel Plating Slab, Chronosteel Plating Stairs.
